calculation.description: Measures recent five-session return relative to a quarter of the trailing twenty-session return, normalized by trailing 20-day annualized-like realized volatility. Positive values indicate improving trend impulse; the daily cross-sectional median is subtracted. Signal uses only completed daily closes.

validation.regime_notes: 15-asset cross-asset universe; 2,245 qualifying daily cross-sectional observations with mean 11.18 valid instruments. Full-history H10 result is positive, with positive subperiods in 2023-2030 and 2035 YTD; weaker but positive 2031-2034. H5 also positive while H1 and H20 are approximately neutral/negative. Interpret uncertainty conservatively because the cross-section is small and coverage is limited by synchronized history.
